blocks.en: Pseudo-monotone Operators
blocks.zh: 伪单调算子
blocks.label: subsec:pseudo-monotone-operators

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In this section we examine a somewhat more general class of nonlinear mappings, called \emph{pseudo-monotone operators}. In applications, it often occurs that the hypotheses imposed in the previous section are unnecessarily strong. In particular, the monotonicity assumption \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-monotonicity} involves both the first-order derivatives and the function itself. As we shall see in this chapter, it is really only necessary to have a monotonicity assumption on the highest-order derivatives: Compactness will take care of the lower-order terms.
blocks.zh: 本节考察一类稍为一般的非线性映射, 称为\emph{伪单调算子}. 在应用中, 前一节施加的假设往往强得没有必要. 特别地, 单调性假设 \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-monotonicity} 同时涉及一阶导数和函数本身. 正如本章将看到的, 实际上只需对最高阶导数作单调性假设: 紧性将处理低阶项.

blocks.en: Let $a_i$ satisfy hypotheses (\ref{hyp:cv-pde-spatial-continuity}--\ref{hyp:cv-pde-uniform-gradient-coercivity}), and let $p$ and $q$ be as defined in hypothesis \ref{hyp:cv-pde-growth}. blocks.label: ex:bounded-monotone-implies-pseudo-monotone
blocks.en: Show that a bounded, monotone operator is pseudo-monotone.
blocks.zh: 证明有界的单调算子为伪单调算子.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: ex:pseudo-monotone-strong-to-weak-continuity
blocks.en: Show that if $T$ is a pseudo-monotone operator and $u_j\to\overline u$ (strongly) in $X$, then $T(u_j)\rightharpoonup T(\overline u)$ in $X^*$.
blocks.zh: 证明, 若 $T$ 为伪单调算子, 且 $u_j\to\overline u$ 在 $X$ 中 (强) 收敛, 则 $T(u_j)\rightharpoonup T(\overline u)$ 在 $X^*$ 中成立.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: ex:cv-type-operator-hemicontinuity
blocks.en: Show that an operator of the calculus of variations type is hemicontinuous. (Thus, by Problem~\ref{ex:pseudo-monotone-hemicontinuity-surjectivity}, we can drop the hypothesis of continuity in Corollary~\ref{cor:cv-type-surjectivity} and the conclusion still holds.)
blocks.zh: 证明变分法型算子为半连续的. (因此, 由 Problem~\ref{ex:pseudo-monotone-hemicontinuity-surjectivity}, 可去掉 Corollary~\ref{cor:cv-type-surjectivity} 中的连续性假设, 而结论仍成立.)

blocks.label: ex:cv-pde-drift-example-hypotheses
blocks.en: Show that there is a $\widetilde C>0$ such that if \eqref{eq:cv-quasilinear-negative-zero-order-coefficient-bound} holds, then hypotheses \ref{hyp:cv-pde-spatial-continuity}--\ref{hyp:cv-pde-uniform-gradient-coercivity} are satisfied for the quasilinear differential operator $\widetilde A$ defined in \eqref{eq:cv-quasilinear-anisotropic-drift-example}. Identify which of the hypotheses \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-measurability}--\ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth} do \emph{not} hold for this operator.
blocks.zh: 证明存在 $\widetilde C>0$, 使得若 \eqref{eq:cv-quasilinear-negative-zero-order-coefficient-bound} 成立, 则 \eqref{eq:cv-quasilinear-anisotropic-drift-example} 定义的拟线性微分算子 $\widetilde A$ 满足假设 \ref{hyp:cv-pde-spatial-continuity}--\ref{hyp:cv-pde-uniform-gradient-coercivity}. 指出假设 \ref{hyp:monotone-pde-measurability}--\ref{hyp:monotone-pde-growth} 中哪些对该算子\emph{不}成立.
